Top 10 crepes fillings (Crepes Cherry Filling)
By: A Kitchen Advisor
Published: Thursday, October 22, 2020 - 4:10pm

Ingredients




16 fl oz whipping cream
1/2 cup sugar
2 cans each 19 fl oz can cherry pie filling
1 oz pure semi-sweet chocolate

Preparation

1 Whisk Whipping Cream with sugar until it becomes fluffy. 2 Open cans with Cherry filling and fill crepes with them in a tube-style rolls. 3 Place 6 crepes in a row on the rectangular plate. 4 Spread Whipped cream over the 1st layer of a cake. 5 Make 2nd layer. It should be 1 crepe less than the 1st layer. In our case – 5. 6 Now spread Whipped cream over the 2nd layer of the cake. 7 Keep building the crepe pyramid. You have to use all 21 crepes to build 5 layers. 8 Once the crepe cake is built, spread the whipped cream over all the sides of the cake thoroughly. 9 Decorate the crepe cake with the grated chocolate. 10 Refrigerate for a couple of hours. For better results keep the cake in the fridge over night.

It is an easy and fancy recipe. Surprisingly it doesn't take a lot of time: 20 minutes and it is ready. No baking, no frying.
